description: This source file provides utility functions to resolve and run npm command line tools, compatible with different platforms (Windows and POSIX). It contains functions for escaping command line arguments, building command lines, and resolving the paths to npm executables or scripts based on environment and platform conditions.

methods.name: resolvePathEnvKey
methods.description: Finds the environment variable key that represents the system PATH, case-insensitive, defaulting to 'PATH'.

methods.name: escapeForCmdExe
methods.description: Escapes command line arguments for Windows cmd.exe, checking for unsafe characters and quoting as necessary.

methods.name: buildCmdExeCommandLine
methods.description: Builds a command line string for Windows cmd.exe from a command and array of arguments, properly escaped.

methods.name: resolveToolchainNpmRunner
methods.description: Attempts to locate npm CLI scripts or binaries relative to a given Node.js installation, returning command and args for execution.
